sources.material_finding: Qwen3_5VisionModel returns both pre-merger last_hidden_state and merged pooler_output from one visual forward; get_image_features exposes the merged image feature path before language decoding.
libmtmd exposes the media embedding buffer from the last encode pass through mtmd_get_output_embd and batch equivalent; public API shown does not expose pre-merger vision hidden states.
Official retrieval architecture uses a separately trained multimodal embedding model; implementation pools the last non-padding multimodal hidden state and L2 normalizes it.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker: A Unified Framework for State-of-the-Art Multimodal Retrieval and Ranking
sources.material_finding: The embedding model is trained through a multimodal retrieval-specific multi-stage pipeline, strengthening the counterhypothesis that raw generative vision features are not automatically calibrated retrieval/open-set features.
Qwen3.5 multimodal server crash behavior varies with Flash Attention, KV layout and text-before-image conditions.
Certain batch/ubatch settings produced irrelevant or blank-image Qwen3.5 vision behavior, showing that successful execution/token counts are insufficient evidence of perception correctness.
Reported server/MTMD fine-grained OCR regression while CLI remained correct, motivating interface differential and preprocessing/grid fidelity tests.
Reported auto-fit GPU-memory estimate omitted mmproj costs, motivating explicit vision runtime resource reservation tests.
Reported EXIF orientation handling mismatch motivates pixel canonicalization before identity/prototype admission.

truth_rule: Issue reports are failure evidence and test generators, not universal claims about every current build or target host. Target-runtime measurements remain required.
